summary: Array-valued source colors silently become black in generated catalog.
claim: CatalogTool uses variant.string(color_hex) ?: #000000.1517 source variants have color arrays; independent all-package comparison finds2785 primary-color mismatches.
suggested_remediation: Preserve source primary and secondary colors end-to-end; do not default missing values to black. Regenerate catalog and show loss preview for formats with less color capacity.
suggested_validation: Independent source-to-generated comparison across all22347 package rows reports zero primary mismatches; multi-color fixtures retain all known colors and format-limits are explicit.
